Subject: Contoso renewal – pricing options
Body:
Hi Daniel,

Thanks again for the candid conversation at the QBR. As promised, here is where I've landed on pricing for the FY27 renewal.

Your current order form allows an uplift of up to 7% at renewal. Given the market conditions you described, I'm proposing to cap the uplift at 5% for the renewal term. Everything else stays as it is today: all 14 subsidiaries, EU data residency and our 1-hour P1 response.

I'm also working with our Product team on the SSO roadmap commitment Lidia asked for, so we can put it in writing in the formal proposal.

Best,
Megan

Megan Bowen
Account Executive, Northwind Ltd

Subject: RE: Contoso renewal – pricing options
Body:
Hi Megan,

Thanks for this. I have to be honest: Fabrikam's offer is about 15% below what we pay you today, and our CFO has seen it. Any increase is a hard sell while our order volumes are down.

Is there more room here?

Daniel

Subject: RE: Contoso renewal – pricing options
Body:
Hi Daniel,

I understand the pressure. I can't match a discount, and I don't think a like-for-like comparison gets you there: Fabrikam's headline number doesn't include EU data residency or a 1-hour P1 response, and moving 14 subsidiaries is a long migration.

What I can do is hold the cap at 5%, below the 7% in the contract, and put the SSO roadmap commitment in writing in the proposal. Can we agree on that?

Best,
Megan

Subject: RE: Contoso renewal – pricing options
Body:
Megan,

Agreed: we can work with a 5% cap on the renewal uplift. Please send the formal renewal proposal before the end of November, with the SSO roadmap commitment in writing, and I'll take it to our CFO.

Daniel
